implementations.js: the gateway's TS port (workers/mcp-gateway), and the web through the wasm core

format: Each case: input = {cards: [{id, keptAt}], answers: [{answerID, subject, at, rating?, gradeState?, counted?}], offsets: {samples: [{at, seconds}]}} with times in ms since 1970 and offsets in seconds east of UTC, each sample in effect from its instant on (the host computes them for the case's zone, which is named only for the reader). expect = each card's schedule: today's scheduler (MemoryTutorScheduler version 2) run in that zone over the answers that count (counted is not false, the subject is crd:<id>), once each by answerID, in (at, answerID) order. A failed or pending answer counts with no rating.
generator: ForeverLMApp/UnitTests/Sync/CardScheduleFoldTests.swift checks the file against the scheduler; the cases were written by a scratch generator over the same code
